final_note: FINAL statuses. The concurrency matrix (N=2,3,10 with N=10 three times), the seven-point SIGKILL crash matrix with both controls, and the closing regression all ran against this head and are internally bound to it via repo_head.

R1.title: Concurrency-safe identifiers; read-then-write over an unlocked append prohibited

R3.title: Idempotent writes; duplicate detection independent of an invalidatable read
evidence: append-time re-verification under the lock (append:after-uniqueness re-read)

evidence: torn-line fixture names exact file and line and validation continues across files

R6.title: Deterministic contention tests
evidence: all six barrier points exercised: allocation+append by unit tests, all four finalization boundaries by real SIGKILL trials with sentinel proof

R7.title: validate exits 0 after N concurrent runs, N in {2,3,10}, zero duplicate ids, ADRs unique and unmodified
evidence: evidence/p0b17-final-n{2,3}.json + p0b17-final-n10-run{1,2,3}.json, all_clean true, validate exit 0, repo_head bound

R8.title: Abandoned-worker recovery; ownership distinguishes in-progress from abandoned
evidence: test/recover.test.ts: live-owner refusal, dead-owner reclaim, foreign/corrupt quarantine

quarantine records with claimant identity and timestamps

evidence: p0b17-final-*: exactly N terminal rows at N=2,3,10x3
